name: desktop_window_move
description:
Move a window to the specified screen position.

The window is matched by a case-insensitive substring of its title.
`x` and `y` set the new position of the window's top-left corner in pixels.

title.description: Window title or substring to match

x.description: New X position of the window's top-left corner

y.description: New Y position of the window's top-left corner
